description: This file defines the Kyrgyz (ky-KG) locale culture information for the DateJS library, including date and time formats, names of days and months, regex patterns for parsing, timezone info, and associated utility functions.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the day index from its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the month index from its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Checks if a year is leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month.
